name: Deepgram
shortDescription: Speech-to-text API with fast, accurate transcription models built for developer integration.
description: Deepgram provides speech-to-text as a clean developer API: fast, accurate transcription models with word-level timestamps, diarization, and streaming support. It powers the voice features in Replicator, turning spoken input into text that the rest of an LLM pipeline can work with — transcription as infrastructure rather than a product bolted on.
useCases: Voice input for LLM-powered editing and content workflows
Accurate transcription with word-level timestamps and diarization
Streaming speech-to-text for responsive voice interfaces
